partintro.section:
&reftitle.intro;
The Snmp\Mib enum lists the options that control how the Net-SNMP library parses MIB files. They are set with snmp_set_mib_option, and allow reading MIB files that do not strictly follow the SMI syntax.

&reftitle.enumsynopsis;
Snmp
Mib
AllowUnderscores
Allow the underscore character (_) in MIB object names and other symbols. This is not valid SMI syntax, but some vendor MIB files use it. Corresponds to the -Pu command-line option and the mibAllowUnderline configuration token of Net-SNMP.
CommentTerm
Make every comment extend to the end of the line. Strictly speaking, a second -- on the same line ends a comment, which is the default behaviour, but this breaks some MIB files. Corresponds to the -Pc command-line option and the commentToEOL configuration token of Net-SNMP.
Replace
If the same MIB object (parent name and sub-identifier) is defined more than once, use the definition that was read last. By default, the first definition is used, and later ones are discarded. Corresponds to the -PR command-line option and the mibReplaceWithLatest configuration token of Net-SNMP.
